name: Biophysics PhD Program
detailsNote: Priority and rolling dates are published without a year, so they are not confirmed for Fall 2027. The Biophysics page does not state a GRE policy or how students are admitted, and the College of Science application page does not list Biophysics by name, so its general PhD requirements are used.
summary: PhD in biophysics at Northeastern's College of Science. Students do lab rotations with faculty across departments and receive tuition, a stipended assistantship and health insurance.

publishedDeadlines.label: Priority deadline (fall)
publishedDeadlines.note: Published without a year on the program page and the College of Science how-to-apply page. Confirm the Fall 2027 date.

publishedDeadlines.label: Rolling admissions (fall)
publishedDeadlines.note: Published without a year. The how-to-apply page says to check with the department to see if there is availability.

english.note: Proof of English proficiency is required for all applicants and programs: a degree earned or in progress at a US institution, or official TOEFL iBT, IELTS, PTE or Duolingo English Test scores. Scores are valid for 2 years from the test date. No minimum scores are stated.

applicationFee.note: The College of Science page lists a $100 fee for PhD applicants and does not mention waivers.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from all institutions attended
requirements.note: These are the College of Science's PhD requirements; its page does not list Biophysics separately. The page lists GRE policies for other PhD programs but not Biophysics.

funding.note: The program page says that for the duration of their program, students receive a full tuition scholarship, a graduate assistant position with stipend, and health insurance. No amount or year is stated.
